description: Image Description: The image features a classic black steam locomotive, numbered "110" in bold yellow digits on its front circular plate. The locomotive is positioned on a set of railway tracks, with its large cylindrical boiler and prominent smokestack clearly visible. It has a traditional design, including a headlight mounted above the number plate and two American flags attached to poles on either side of the front. The train's front includes a robust metal grille and a cowcatcher designed to clear obstacles
